# Sourdough starter care

Feed the starter twice a day at room temperature with equal weights of flour and water (100% hydration). Discard all but 50 g before each feeding.

## When it is ready

The starter is ready when it doubles within six hours of a feeding and smells mildly sour. A layer of grey liquid (hooch) means it is hungry: stir it in or pour it off, then feed.

## Storage

Keep it in the fridge between bakes and feed it once a week. Take it out a day before baking and give it two feedings.
